summary.text: Christine Seibert is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 21 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Seibert's career experience includes working as an activist, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Christine Seibert graduated from Parkview High School.
Ballotpedia lists her affiliations as Rights and Democracy, NHYD, NHDP and Open Democracy.
Seibert lost a Hillsborough 8 primary in 2018, then won the Hillsborough 21 general elections on November 8, 2022 and November 5, 2024.
Her 2023-2024 committee assignment was the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs Committee.
